Name: Set up Stripe subscription tiers
Description: Taylor to configure Stripe with three subscription tiers: Basic ($29/month), Pro ($49/month), and Enterprise ($99/month) according to the pricing and feature details provided by Alex. This includes creating the plans in Stripe and ensuring they are ready for integration.

Name: Develop frontend checkout process with Stripe Elements
Description: Jordan to implement the Stripe Elements-based checkout form on the frontend. The form must match the app's clean and straightforward design, include a clear comparison of subscription features for each tier, a prominent checkout button, and a tooltip explaining plan changes. The form must also handle errors gracefully, such as invalid card details or insufficient funds.

Name: Update pricing page with new subscription tiers
Description: Jordan to update the app's pricing page to reflect the three subscription tiers (Basic, Pro, Enterprise) with their features and prices as described by Alex. The page should clearly communicate what users get at each level.

Name: Implement user dashboard subscription management
Description: Jordan to develop dashboard functionality allowing users to view current plan details, billing information, upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscriptions, access invoices and payment history, and update payment methods. The dashboard must update subscription status in real-time and notify users of changes such as successful upgrades or payment failures.

Name: Integrate Stripe API for subscription management
Description: Taylor to integrate Stripe's API on the backend to create and manage subscriptions, process payments, and handle webhook events. This includes creating subscriptions upon payment completion, handling payment successes and failures, and managing subscription cancellations.

Name: Set up and test webhook handlers for Stripe events
Description: Taylor to implement webhook handlers for the events invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed, and customer.subscription.deleted. The handlers must update the system accordingly, notify users of payment failures via email, and manage subscription cancellation effects. Taylor will create test scenarios simulating these events and prepare a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for the entire subscription flow.

Name: Integrate frontend with backend subscription API
Description: Jordan to connect frontend components to the backend API developed by Taylor to ensure real-time reflection of subscription changes on the user dashboard. This includes handling user notifications for subscription confirmations, payment errors, and other relevant events.

Name: Create user documentation and help resources
Description: Alex, Jordan, and Taylor to collaborate on producing clear user documentation and support materials. This includes instructions on managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, handling payment issues, and an FAQ section covering common subscription questions. Taylor will also document API endpoints and webhook handlers for maintenance and troubleshooting purposes.
